glade-hello.speaker: narrator
glade-hello.text: This is your Home Glade. Walk to the Star Gate to fly off on an adventure!

mirror.speaker: narrator
mirror.text: Press down at the mirror to dress up!

tree.speaker: narrator
tree.text: Press down at the sticker tree to see your stickers!

crystal-0.speaker: narrator
crystal-0.text: The Heart Crystal has lost all its colors. Where did they go?

crystal-1.speaker: narrator
crystal-1.text: The Heart Crystal has 1 color back. 4 more to find!

crystal-2.speaker: narrator
crystal-2.text: The Heart Crystal has 2 colors back. 3 more to find!

crystal-3.speaker: narrator
crystal-3.text: The Heart Crystal has 3 colors back. 2 more to find!

crystal-4.speaker: narrator
crystal-4.text: The Heart Crystal has 4 colors back. Just 1 more!

crystal-need-pip.speaker: narrator
crystal-need-pip.text: All the colors are home! But the crystal feels lonely. Who is still missing?

crystal-finale.speaker: narrator
crystal-finale.text: The Heart Crystal shines with every color! You solved the mystery!

crystal-done.speaker: narrator
crystal-done.text: The Heart Crystal is shining bright, thanks to you!

star-gate-hint.speaker: narrator
star-gate-hint.text: Look! A Star Gate! Step inside to fly to the Sky Map.

pip-sky-family.speaker: pip
pip-sky-family.text: Look! The Heart Crystal showed me the Sky Map. My family are the Guardian Stars, and they are lost! My big sister Luma fell into the sea. Will you help me find her?
